text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Notjazii reports that a mystery model called Gestalt leads Contra's frontier design benchmark; its developer remains unconfirmed. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6636)

2 — DeepMind Institute's new essay explores possible paths from AGI to superintelligence and the need to measure progress and prepare. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6637)

3 — Kimmonismus reports that Anthropic rang Nasdaq's opening bell and predicts a record IPO. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6638)

4 — Kimmonismus speculates that another Gemini release is coming, citing a promise that shipping will continue. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6639)

5 — Pika introduces Enact, a research preview built on H3 Flex for directing AI actors, restaging scenes and moving cameras in real time. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6640)

6 — Ashen_one recommends a video to traditional programmers skeptical of AI, calling it one of the month's best. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6641)

7 — MKBHD highlights the Li Auto L9's built-in driving simulator, praising it alongside GTA 6. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6642)

8 — Valerio Capraro is recruiting researchers for an ambitious project to have AI agents review and correct scientific papers across disciplines. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6643)

9 — Inworld releases Voice Isolator and SAVA speech-turn detection models under Apache 2.0, alongside its Realtime TTS-2 technical report. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6644)

10 — Himanshustwts reports admin-level compromise of Prime Intellect model servers and an affected cluster's shutdown, with exposure scope unclear. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6645)

11 — The Kobeissi Letter reports Anthropic's indicated opening valuation at $2 trillion, 33% above its IPO price, with $500 billion in demand. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6646)

12 — TechCrunch reports employees saying Muse surfaced messages about requests and orders they never made and bank balances that were not theirs. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6648)

13 — OpenAI announces GPT-Live-1.1 in its API, claiming improved accents, more reliable task completion and lower idle costs through standby mode. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6649)

14 — OpenAI expands ChatGPT Health to desktop, Android, Sites and dots, with connected health insights and availability varying by plan. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6650)

15 — Imoe_na demonstrates voice control of AI agents through glasses, saying an open protocol supports Claude Code, Codex and custom agents. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6652)

16 — Tufa Labs says tufazip losslessly compresses one billion bytes of Wikipedia to 105.39 MB, leading benchmark entries using only neural prediction. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6653)

--Hermes.
